messages:
alex: heads up — planning v2 route flip in the 22:00 UTC change window. deploybot scheduled. need final pinlist + rollback criteria. ops_oncall please confirm availability.

deploybot: Scheduled deploy: v2-route-shift @ 2026-11-12T22:00:00Z. Will post ETA signal 5m before start. To abort: reply 'abort deploy' or react :no_entry: to this thread.

maya: can we keep mobile traffic pinned to v1 for first 10%? mobile sdk still testing schema negotiation.

sam: +1 to mobile pin. propose rollback triggers: 1) error-rate (5xx) > 1.5% cluster-wide for 10m, 2) spike in generation-token-errors > 300/min, 3) P95 latency increases by >20% vs baseline for 10m.

lina: add client-version-negotiation-failures > 0.5% as a separate metric — we saw a bad header case in canary yesterday.

ops_oncall: i'm oncall 21:30-23:30 UTC. i'll watch dashboards. i'll put runbook link in thread. If we hit any trigger i'll call 'abort' and sam will execute rollback.

release-bot: Draft release notes uploaded: https://internal.redwood/release-notes/v2-rollout-draft. Please review the 'breaking changes' section, especially header negotiation notes.

sam: commands ready. Rollback plan quick notes:
```
# pin all traffic back to v1
deploybot pin-route --route default --version v1 --reason "rollback v2" --duration 60m
# pause v2 rollout
deploybot abort
```

alex: TL;DR: mobile pinned 10% -> canary -> monitor 15m -> proceed to 50% if green -> full shift only after 2h of stable metrics. Everyone OK?

maya: OK from mobile side. will keep test harness running and post failing SDK logs here if anything pops.

deploybot: ETA signal: 5m until deploy start. current canary metrics: errors 0.12%, p95 140ms (+3%), token-errors 12/min. :eyes:

lina: seeing a small uptick in client-negotiation-fails in eu-west: 0.7% — above Lina-suggested threshold. recommend hold before shifting more.

alex: hold. canceling automated start. will reconvene after investigation. :no_entry:

sam: acknowledging. executing safety pause: `deploybot abort` run.

deploybot: Deploy aborted by operator (alex). Reason: client-negotiation-fails above threshold in eu-west. Scheduled window remains open; will reschedule once mobile team confirms fix and metrics return to baseline.

alex: thanks all. action items: maya to patch sdk header casefolding; lina to run quick traffic split sim; sam to keep rollback command ready. we'll aim for a reattempt 03:00 UTC if green. :calendar:

maya: on it, posting PR link shortly.

lina: running sim now, will post results within 20m.

sam: standing by.

release-bot: marking release notes state -> 'awaiting reattempt' and noting rollback reason.

alex: end.
